propositions: Non-create operation families must route through coordinator and fuse instead of legacy ad-hoc retry, gated by per-family internal selector with no dual-send.
Deferral metadata (scope, reason, retry_not_before) must be explicitly persisted and applied tallies must preserve exact counts of applied, failed, deferred, skipped, and recovered outcomes.

All per-mutation guards (lost-lease check, HEAD-drift recheck, rebar-id audit) and batch preconditions (cross-project, blast-radius) must remain in force at their original enforcement points in the execute closure and preconditions.
Historical replay of 1,200-run sanitized slice must show zero premature fuse termination of previously observed successful or partially successful work.
Coordinator routing must remain confined to batch_dispatch.py as a thin adapter; applier.py must not exceed 800 LOC and legacy ad-hoc nesting must become unreachable for migrated families.

Venue-gated Cloud and DC verified-fake tests must drive the coordinator cutover with real guarded execute closure and assert wire output, call ceilings, and five-bucket tallies before the coordinator default changes.
